questions.question: Explain how a corporate objective is developed from a mission statement. (4 marks)
Construct Ansoff's Matrix, labelling both dimensions and naming all four cells. (4 marks)

Adisa Home makes household appliances and takes $100m a year, 48% of it from water heaters in a market growing at 2% a year where it holds 32%. It is choosing between taking its existing heaters into a neighbouring country and developing a solar water heater for the customers it already has. Assess which of the two it should pursue. (12 marks)

Adisa Home is deciding whether to defend its broad low-cost position in water heaters or build a narrow position in off-grid pumps for remote farms. Analyse the implications of choosing the narrow position. (6 marks)

Adisa Home's revenue by line is: water heaters $48m, refrigerators $30m, air conditioners $18m and solar pumps $4m. Adisa Home holds 6% of the air conditioner market. Calculate (a) the percentage of total revenue coming from air conditioners and solar pumps together, and (b) the total value of the air conditioner market. (4 marks)

Adisa Home is choosing between committing $25m to a second production line and running a four-week discount to clear refrigerator stock. Discuss the effects of these two decisions on the firm's human, physical and financial resources. (8 marks)
Construct a SWOT grid for Adisa Home, labelling both dimensions and placing one item in each of the four cells. (4 marks)

Adisa Home holds 6% of a $300m air conditioner market growing at 14% a year, and is considering committing $25m to a second production line to expand that share. Evaluate whether the external environment supports this decision. (20 marks)

leaves.wording: Development of corporate objectives from mission statement/corporate aims.
Effect of strategic and tactical decisions on human, physical, and financial resources.
PESTLE (political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental).
